dedupe_keys.name: software package for reconfiguration robust spatiotemporal learning for dynamic ev hosting capacity estimation in distribution feeders

description: University of Alberta researchers publish a Python workflow for estimating dynamic electric-vehicle hosting capacity across feeder reconfigurations. The software-only Zenodo archive and GitHub code are free under the MIT licence. Scripts prepare OpenDSS quasi-static results, graph features and capacity labels, then train a graph-attention model and neural-network baselines with PyTorch and PyTorch Geometric. A base configuration and five switching scenarios define the documented coverage. The model can support surrogate screening within charging-capacity simulations. Related G6 data-dynamic-ev-hosting-capacity-reconfiguration-benchmarks supplies data and checkpoints; catalogue data-iowa-distribution-test-systems supplies underlying third-party assets. Regenerating simulations requires Windows and OpenDSS COM, while released project data use separate CC BY terms. Prediction error does not guarantee feasible operation under unseen conditions. Nothing was installed, trained or evaluated.
